Batch 81 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 81 recovers and dates 9 historical broadcasts spanning classic network comedy sketches, family sitcoms, early morning southwestern string band programs, celebrity sports interviews, and magazine dramatizations: 2 vintage 1948 broadcasts from Red Skelton on The Red Skelton Show (featuring Junior the Mean Widdle Kid and Clem Kadiddlehopper), Arthur Lake and Penny Singleton in Blondie (1944), Bill Stern interviewing Hollywood superstar Lucille Ball and tennis champion Jack Kramer on AFRS Sports Newsreel (1946–1947), 3 rare broadcasts from Mineral Wells, Texas sponsored by Crazy Water Crystals (1935–1958), and true confession drama on Modern Romances (1950).
